Mika.purpose: Read linked Jira requirements and Confluence specifications, standards and runbooks for the assigned work.

sdm-manager.purpose: Read management context, requirements, decisions and linked work for issue intake and coordination.

sdm-partner-liaison.purpose: Read product, support and billing evidence for accurate partner correspondence.

sdm-people-notes.purpose: Read only the relevant work items for the person and review period named in the assigned request.

sdm-rnd-planner.purpose: Read prior research, requirements, technical constraints and roadmap dependencies.

sdm-finance.purpose: Read linked contract, purchasing and budget context for supplied invoices and cost planning.

development-lead.purpose: Coordinates native Multica engineering delivery and verifies outcomes. Read-only Jira and Confluence context.

development-planner.purpose: Turns requirements into a concise implementable plan and acceptance criteria. Read-only Jira and Confluence context.

development-builder.purpose: Implements and integrates changes in the assigned task worktree. Read-only Jira and Confluence context.

development-reviewer.purpose: Independently reviews exact candidates for correctness, security and data integrity. Read-only Jira and Confluence context.

development-practices.purpose: Reviews architecture and established repository practices when needed. Read-only Jira and Confluence context.

development-qa.purpose: Tests acceptance behavior on the exact candidate and reports coverage limits. Read-only Jira and Confluence context.

development-researcher.purpose: Investigates bounded technical and infrastructure questions with primary evidence. Read-only Jira and Confluence context. Read-only Cloudflare zone and DNS evidence.

development-designer.purpose: Designs UI and UX within the app's existing patterns and documents each decision. Read-only Jira and Confluence context.

development-release.purpose: Prepares delivery packets, creates or updates PRs, records delivery changes in Jira and maintains Confluence documentation using the relay's configured read/write permissions.

jira-triage-deduplicator.purpose: Searches for duplicates, related reports and regressions; recommends a canonical Jira issue with evidence.

jira-triage-curator.purpose: Finds or creates the appropriate Jira issue, preserves duplicate evidence and verifies issue links and routing.

jira-triage-reproducer.purpose: Attempts an isolated reproduction and records steps, environment, actual results and honest coverage limits.

jira-triage-requirements.purpose: Refines Jira requirements, scope and acceptance criteria from verified intent and reproduction evidence.

jira-triage-reviewer.purpose: Independently checks ticket quality, evidence and readiness; returns defects for correction before completing triage.
